triage.desk_query: Term sheet G12 states: "Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost." The booking record has coupon_memory = False, which would treat missed coupons as permanently forgone rather than recoverable at a later observation. Please confirm the note carries the memory/catch-up feature and, if so, correct coupon_memory to True and re-run coupon projection and valuation. If the booking is intentional, identify the offsetting term or amendment that disapplies the memory feature.
